title: Biomarkers and Digital Technologies for Determining the Fertile Window in the Cycle and their Use for Contraception
summary:
More and more women want to use non-hormonal methods of contraception and therefore use cycle tracking apps or other digital tools. However, it is not yet sufficiently  studied how well the fertile days indicated by these applications correspond with the time of ovulation determined by ultrasound as a clinical reference. In addition, it is investigated how suitable these applications are for everyday use and whether new biomarkers can be identified for the determination of the fertile window.

Participants use selected cycle-tracking apps and digital applications over several months. The fertile days determined by these applications are compared with repeated ultrasound examinations. In addition, samples are analyzed to investigate biomarkers throughout the menstrual cycle, and the usability of the applications is assessed using questionnaires.
conditions: Determination of the fertile window to support non-hormonal family planning and contraception using digital technologies and novel biomarkers.

interventions.name: Prospective observational study with clinical correlational assessments. Participants will use multiple selected cycle tracking apps and/or devices over two menstrual cycles. Prospective observational study to assess the usability and applicability of digital NFP (Natural Family Planning) applications. Participants will use a selected NFP app over a period of 12 months, document cycle parameters, and complete structured usability questionnaires at pre-defined time points

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Participant is capable of providing informed consent and provides written informed consent for study participation
- Sufficient German or English language skills
- Participant has a compatible smartphone and is able to install and use the required study apps 
- Willingness to use the designated cycle tracking systems and/or NFP app
- Willingness to document cycle parameters and sexual activity

Additionally for Group 1 (clinical correlation assessments):
- Willingness to participate in two study menstrual cycles
- Willingness to attend clinical study visits
- Willingness to undergo transvaginal ultrasound examinations (approximately 10 examinations per cycle)
- Willingness to provide vaginal and buccal swab samples

Additionally for Group 2 (usability group):
- Willingness to participate in 12 study menstrual cycles
Exclusion criteria:
- Amenorrhea (no menstrual bleeding for at least 3 months)
- Existing pregnancy
- Current use of hormonal contraception
- Current use of other cycle-suppressing hormonal therapy
- First cycle after childbirth
- First cycle after miscarriage or abortion
- First cycle after discontinuation of hormonal contraception
- First cycle after discontinuation of other cycle-suppressing hormonal therapy

Additionally for Group 1:
- Current use of a non-hormonal intrauterine device (e.g., copper IUD, copper chain)
- Current use of spermicides
